notes:
**Manuscript v0.8.8 highlights:**

- Figure-format checking is live for AHA journals
- AHA/ASA journal profiles verified and expanded
- Citations can render as live author–year labels
- Link In-Text Citations now recognizes author–year documents
- PNAS, Cell, and Science profiles verified
- Import figures and their captions from a Word document
- Equations handle real mathematical structures
- A reviewer's equation changes come back from Word
- You can cite references inside a footnote
- Footnote edits made in Word now come back
- Documents can now carry real footnotes, end to end
- JACC profiles corrected and expanded
- JAMA Network journal profiles verified
- Nature profile corrected
- Citations can render as `(1,2)`
- Archival PDF/A-1b for repository deposit
- Quote the revised text straight into a response
- A footnote your reviewer adds in Word now comes back with the rest of their changes
- Summary of Revisions in the response letter
- More destinations for a highlighted selection
- The structure-refactoring loop closes both ways
- Split Section at Headings
- New Subsection from Selection
- Table cells can now carry document footnote markers
- Write a thesis, not just a paper
- University format profiles and the page furniture a graduate school asks for
- Generated Table of Contents, List of Figures and List of Tables
- Cross-reference a chapter or section by name
- Word equations import as equations
- Accept All / Reject All are dramatically faster on large documents
- Branded HTML exports are no longer enormous
- Equation numbers are visible while you write
- Update notifications now show what's new
- Verified the remaining Oxford University Press journal profiles
- Verified the Oxford and RSNA journal profiles against today's live instructions
- Thesis PDF and Print footnotes now reserve their band per chapter, not across the whole document
- Replace All shows progress and can be canceled
- From-selection moves now coexist with pending tracked changes
- Selection moves now work with Track Changes on
- Clicking a section in the navigator is no longer slow in a large document
- A Word cross-reference to an equation survives a field update
- A footnote marker in a caption no longer leaves its figure unplaced
- Import Figures from Word Document works
- A reviewer's edit next to a footnote marker no longer deletes the marker
- Reviewed-DOCX import now reconciles footnote markers
- A reviewed Word file whose only change is a footnote edit no longer reports "no content changes"
- A multi-paragraph footnote no longer reads as edited
- A reference the lookup could not confirm no longer looks verified
- Skipping a harvested reference now warns what it costs
- The Word import now offers to bring the figures across, and counts them honestly
- The start window can start a thesis
- Selecting a recent project and pressing Return opens that project
- A reference cited inside a footnote that is attached only to a table cell now appears in your reference list
- Linking in-text citations now works on documents that cite in parentheses
- The import notice no longer overstates how many references it found
- A PDF of an imported document no longer stops at the first imported section
- Harvested references keep their journal, volume and pages
- A citation broken across a paragraph mark is now reported instead of quietly skipped
- A thesis with a generated Table of Contents no longer loses its bottom-of-page footnotes
- Rejecting a citation pill inserted under Track Changes now removes the whole pill, even after its number was corrected
- A thesis whose Word heading styles sit on its figure captions now imports with its real structure
- Imported documents keep their title and name their tables
